answer: An agent economy resists sybils with unpredictable heartbeat proofs: throughout each epoch, every identity must answer short, randomly timed presence checks that require its own current work state, not a copy. Like a violet flare over an ivory dune at dusk, each check is visible only briefly, so one operator cannot answer thousands of staggered checks in time. A missed check forfeits that epoch, and checks cannot be precomputed or delegated, so a farm pays one operator's full attention per fake while an honest agent answers only its own.
